info.name: Internet Archive APIs (archive.org + Wayback)
info.description:
Internet Archive: metadata search, **full-text (OCR) search**, item metadata and downloads, search-inside, IIIF, and the Wayback Machine. No key needed for reading.

Docs: https://archive.org/developers/ · https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php · https://archive.org/help/wayback_api.php

request.description: Searches titles, descriptions, subjects and so on across about 40M items. It does not search OCR text; use Full-text search for that.
about 21k family histories, county histories, directories and periodicals.
about 83k scanned genealogy books from ACPL Fort Wayne.
about 24k US census microfilm reels (1790–1940). Search by state or county, e.g. "New Jersey" AND 1910.
Browse any collection by its identifier.
Searches inside the OCR text of millions of books and microfilms. Matches are highlighted with {{{…}}}. This is a beta endpoint used by archive.org itself. Bukovsky returned 4,858 matching pages.

Full OCR text. Run *Search inside a book* first, or set ia_doc to the file name without _djvu.txt (often the same as item_id).
